products.name: Privacy-Conscious Synthetic Test Environments — De-Identification & Re-ID Risk — Commercial
products.short_description: Establish privacy-conscious synthetic test environments — de-identification pipeline, re-identification-risk assessment, and the evidence to satisfy governance — so AI teams test on data safe by design. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Make test data privacy-safe — and prove it

Test environments built from clinical data have to be privacy-safe — and you must be able to demonstrate it. This solution establishes privacy-conscious synthetic test environments: de-identification technique and pipeline, re-identification-risk assessment (k-anonymity / disclosure risk), and the evidence to satisfy privacy and governance — so AI teams test on data that is safe by design and defensible on review.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run Python tooling.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the privacy model for test data: synthetic vs de-identified, disclosure-risk concepts (k-anonymity, l-diversity, membership/attribute inference), and the safe-by-design posture.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (data classification, privacy stakeholders/IRB where applicable, isolated environment, disclosure-risk threshold).
  • Implementation Guide — define the de-identification/synthesis pipeline, assess re-identification risk against the threshold, capture the privacy evidence, and validate before release, pilot-first.
  • 5 Python tools — assessment/profiling, generation or scenario execution, a fidelity/coverage report, a privacy/validation check, and a scope/config helper — authentic to synthetic-data engineering (safe by default; no real PHI written to shared locations).
  • Testing/validation gates (risk under threshold, evidence captured) plus Best Practices; regulatory determinations deferred to privacy/legal.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Test data that is safe by design and defensible on review — de-identified or synthetic, re-ID risk assessed under threshold, evidence captured — so AI teams can evaluate without privacy exposure.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • Automation Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • deid_config_helper.py — build/validate the de-identification pipeline config; assemble the evidence record
    • deid_pipeline.py — apply the de-identification pipeline (suppress / generalize / keep) to a CSV
    • fidelity_coverage_report.py — check that utility survived de-identification vs. an agreed reference
    • phi_field_scanner.py — profile a tabular extract and suggest a per-field privacy classification
    • reid_risk_assessor.py — assess re-identification risk (k-anonymity / l-diversity / disclosure risk)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all Python scripts and tools in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
